newsitem.title: JAPAN: Lehman Bros says to reorganise Japan operations.
newsitem.headline: Lehman Bros says to reorganise Japan operations.

text.p: Lehman Brothers said on Thursday it would reorganise its Japanese operations, a move that would include a reduction of staff numbers in certain areas of Lehman Brothers Japan. It did not specify the areas.
Lehmans said it would aim in Japan to strengthen higher-margin activities in capital markets and investment-banking businesses.
Lehmans declined to comment on whether the reshuffling of staff between areas would result in an overall staff reduction in its Japanese operation.
It said it plans to integrate its investment banking, fixed income, and equities businesses to provide tailor-made services in the banking and real-estate sectors.
On the investment banking side, it said it would focus on capital raising, M&A, securitisation, and real-estate investments.
In fixed-income markets, it said it would strengthen foreign-exchange options, structured credit derivatives and securitisation.

On the equities side, it said it plans to focus on derivative and derivative-related products, including basket and programme trading, convertible bonds, equity finance and cash-equity trades for clients.
